title: H2A.Z facilitates Sox2-nucleosome interaction by promoting DNA and histone H3 tail mobility.
authors: Moos, Helen K; Patel, Rutika; Flaherty, Sophie K; Loverde, Sharon M; Nikolova, Evgenia N
one_liner_zh: 该文结合MD模拟与NMR研究H2A.Z核小体如何通过增强DNA解链和H3尾动态促进先锋因子Sox2结合，聚焦TF-核小体DNA互作机制，方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合建模。
abstract: Epigenetic regulation of chromatin structure is strongly influenced by histone variants and post-translational modifications. The conserved histone variant H2A.Z has been functionally linked to the pioneer factors Sox2 and Oct4, which open chromatin and activate cell fate-specific transcriptional programs. However, the molecular basis of this interaction is not well understood. Here, we combine biochemistry, NMR spectroscopy, and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to investigate how H2A.Z nucleosome dynamics influence pioneer factor binding. We find that H2A.Z enhances Sox2 and Oct4 association at distinct positions within 601 nucleosomes, correlating with increased DNA accessibility and altered H3 N-terminal tail dynamics. We show that the H3 tail competes with Sox2 for DNA binding and is more efficiently displaced with H2A.Z, while also allowing for unique Sox2-H3 tail interactions. MD simulations reveal that H2A.Z promotes DNA unwrapping, increases inter-gyre spacing, and enhances H3 tail flexibility, while simultaneously reducing contacts with DNA and with the H2A.Z C-terminal tail. This destabilizing effect is DNA-sequence dependent and prominent in the less stable Lin28B nucleosome, which Sox2 appears to substantially reshape. Together, our results suggest that H2A.Z promotes pioneer factor binding by increasing DNA accessibility and reducing histone tail competition, with broad implications for epigenetic regulation and chromatin recognition.
abstract_zh: 染色质结构的表观遗传调控受到组蛋白变体和翻译后修饰的强烈影响。保守的组蛋白变体H2A.Z在功能上与先驱因子Sox2和Oct4相关联，这些因子能够打开染色质并激活细胞命运特异的转录程序。然而，这种相互作用的分子基础尚不明确。在此，我们结合生物化学、核磁共振波谱和分子动力学（MD）模拟，研究H2A.Z核小体动力学如何影响先驱因子结合。我们发现，H2A.Z增强了Sox2和Oct4在601核小体内不同位置的结合，这与DNA可及性增加和H3 N端尾部动力学改变相关。我们证明，H3尾部与Sox2竞争DNA结合，并且在H2A.Z存在时更有效地被置换，同时允许独特的Sox2-H3尾部相互作用。MD模拟揭示，H2A.Z促进DNA解缠绕，增加螺旋间间距，并增强H3尾部灵活性，同时减少与DNA及H2A.Z C端尾部的接触。这种去稳定效应具有DNA序列依赖性，并在稳定性较低的Lin28B核小体中尤为显著，Sox2似乎能显著重塑该核小体。综合来看，我们的结果表明，H2A.Z通过增加DNA可及性和减少组蛋白尾部竞争来促进先驱因子结合，这对表观遗传调控和染色质识别具有广泛意义。
